# Microsoft Family Safety

> > Microsoft's family safety and parental control platform for managing screen time, content filtering, and digital wellbeing across Windows, Xbox, Android, and iOS devices.

Microsoft Family Safety is part of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, providing parents and guardians with tools to protect children online, set screen time limits, filter inappropriate content, and monitor family device usage across multiple platforms including Windows 10, Windows 11, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and mobile devices.
